tagline: Your personal server co-pilot — loud, useful, and built for the crew.
welcome: You made it. I’m Hatclanker, your pocket-sized server mechanic. I’ll show you where everything lives and who to ask when something breaks.

channels.name: #start-here
channels.purpose: Read the essentials and unlock the rest of the server.

channels.name: #announcements
channels.purpose: News, drops, events, and important updates.

channels.name: #general
channels.purpose: The main hangout. Talk, share, and meet the crew.

rules: Don’t be a dick. Debate ideas without attacking members.
No spam, scams, malicious links, or unwanted advertising.
Keep content in the right channel and follow channel topics.
Protect private information — yours and everyone else’s.
Listen to staff and use the help channel if a decision needs review.

faqs.question: How do I get access to the server?
faqs.answer: Head to #start-here, read the rules, and complete the verification or role steps shown there.

faqs.question: Where can I ask for help?
faqs.answer: Use #help-desk and include what you tried, what happened, and a screenshot if it helps.

faqs.question: Where are announcements posted?
faqs.answer: All official updates, events, and drops are posted in #announcements.

faqs.question: Can I promote my own work?
faqs.answer: Only in a channel that explicitly allows promotion. If you are unsure, ask @Staff first.
